Public path: StorySource/SurfaceAnalyzer -> raw FeatureTrack[Token,Double] with Observed, NotInLexicon, and Excluded values -> WindowPlan.words(4,2) -> Windowed Mean under IgnoreMissing versus RequireMinCoverage(0.75). Exact compile/run passed in fixturesJVM with the temporary examples source setting; fresh stdout extraction diffed byte-for-byte against archive (exit 0). Exact output exposes four window supports and coverages: 4/4 => 4.80 under both policies; 4/4 => 2.55; 2/3 => Observed(1.60) versus Missing(Excluded); 0/1 => Missing(AllMissing) versus Missing(Excluded). It also proves policy changes produce distinct derived FeatureSpace ids and the window recipe is recorded. Figure recipe: x-axis token rail with lexical observations as dots, four translucent window bands, coverage numerator/denominator over each, paired markers for permissive/75%-gated outcomes; exact text twin is the archived rows. This covers the previously missing general feature/window/coverage subsystem without shared-path edits.
